sections.title: Cover Letter
sections.content: We are pleased to submit this proposal to Georgia State University for marketing communications services. Our team is prepared to partner with University Communications on brand stewardship and campaign delivery.

sections.title: Key Personnel — Creative Leadership
sections.content: Ron Comer leads creative strategy for complex public-sector and higher-education engagements. With 35+ years of experience across branding, campaign development, and institutional storytelling, he brings seasoned judgment to every creative review. He will personally oversee concept development for the GSU brand platform refresh.

sections.title: Staffing Plan and Hours
sections.content: Our Year 1 staffing allocation anticipates intensive launch support followed by steady-state delivery. Proposed hours by role: Account Director 400 hours, Creative Director 320 hours, Senior Strategist 280 hours, Designer 200 hours, and Project Manager 160 hours. Media planning absorbs approximately 25% of the account hours in Q1, rising to 60% of creative hours during the fall enrollment campaign window. These figures are planning estimates invented for this synthetic fixture and are not grounded in a rate card.

sections.title: Team Bios — Extended
sections.content: Ron Comer has spent 38 years building creative programs for universities and civic clients. His portfolio includes multi-year brand systems and enrollment campaigns. He partners closely with account leadership to keep creative decisions accountable to strategy.
